about: Shawn's requirements for the duck answering to its name (namecall.py). One entry per requirement with his words (local time, America/New_York), the acceptance that decides it, the sim tests that guard it and the live evidence. Add a requirement here in the same turn he states or changes one; report progress and the next task from this file (requirements_check.py prints the gaps). status: met (sim tests and a live readback agree), built (code and sim tests pass, no live readback yet), partial (some live evidence, a known failing case), gap (fails live or not built).

requirements.title: Answers only to Mochi; no answer when nobody called
shawn: 我们要不要给他取个名字 然后叫他的时候它可以转头并叫一下
再把只响应mochi也做进去
现在的问题是它回应得太多了 最后它叫的五声我根本没叫它
我还没交它 它就看着我了
刚才又误触发了一次
requirements.acceptance: In a live test with Shawn present, every answer follows a real call (zero answers he did not make); offline, held-out false wakes per hour on home talk reported with the operating point.
evidence: results/operating_point_20261030.json: 0.9 gives 5.6-7.8 false wakes/h on life segments, 0 on held-out LibriSpeech and RoboClub talk
19:32:18 answer at 0.944 that Shawn reports false
requirements.gap: Live false answers at 10:58 (five) and 19:21:08 (score 0.98, segment life/20261030/192104_427.wav about 2.5-4.5 s, labelled as a negative in life_labels_1030_live.json for the next training). Shawn's own nearby talk is the main false-wake source.

requirements.title: Answers the first call, within about a second
shawn: 为什么要等2秒呢 叫的时候听不到声音不是很正常吗 但2秒就不正常了
我叫了好几次才响应我
但我刚实际叫了两声 却一点反应也没有
requirements.acceptance: Live: the first call of each attempt is answered, the answer starts within 1 s of the call's end; offline: recall on held-out calls at the operating point.
evidence: 18:53 test: two calls scored 0.78-0.83 under the 0.9 threshold, first answer 7.6 s after the first call
results/operating_point_20261030.json: two-stage repeat rule (0.9, or two peaks >= 0.7 started 1-5 s apart) answers about 2 s after the first call at 4 of 5 offsets
19:33:39 and 19:33:41 calls scored 0.73 and 0.82, 1.9 s apart, no answer at 0.9 alone
requirements.gap: Repeat rule (0.9, or two runs >= 0.7 started 1-5 s apart) installed 19:35; not yet seen live. Single calls under 0.9 stay unanswered: the spotter learned from 42 real calls by one speaker.

requirements.title: Turns to the caller's side, front first
shawn: 我在前面叫的 它往左边看 还一直转 然后还打滑不停往错误方向转
requirements.acceptance: Live: the first look lands on the caller's side; a call from the front never starts a body turn; a body turn happens only after the front search found nobody.
evidence: bearing_seen labels collect the true bearing of each call for the direction error
requirements.gap: No live readback of direction error since front-first search was installed.

requirements.title: Looks up to a standing person's height
shawn: 但是他得看我，他得抬头啊。它不能判断高度吗
我在前面叫它这次又看向右边 而不是抬头
requirements.acceptance: Live: after a call from a standing person the camera ends on the face (face event logged).
evidence: 19:21 run: person then face event at 19:22:10
requirements.gap: One live success; no count over several calls.

requirements.title: Head and body turn together, no recentring first
shawn: 我们一般是边转头。边转头边转身，为什么要先回正再转身？感觉很不自然。
requirements.acceptance: Live and sim: during a body turn the head keeps pointing at the bearing (no return to centre before the turn).
requirements.gap: No live body turn observed since the change.

requirements.title: Follows the body up to the face
shawn: 它现在只能看到我的手 它会身体的部分去看脸吗
而且明明看到我的腿了 不知道顺着躯干寻找头 非常蠢
requirements.acceptance: Live: with only legs or torso in view, the head climbs until the face is found (person event before face event).
evidence: 19:21 run: person event, then face at 19:22:10
requirements.gap: One live case; climb from legs only not yet seen live.

requirements.title: Looks at the owner 5-10 s waiting for instructions, then looks away
shawn: 一是看到脸了就转回去站着了 不是应该盯一会儿等待指示嘛
它现在一直盯着我了 也不用一直看着吧 宠物的行为不是这样的
一般盯个5-10秒钟
requirements.acceptance: Live: after the face lock the gaze stays on the face, then the head drifts home 5-10 s later with the face still in view; a new call looks again.
requirements.gap: Two live contacts ended after 6 s; not yet confirmed by Shawn that the face was still in view and that it looked natural.

requirements.title: Steady gaze on the face, no side-to-side swing
shawn: 而且也不是盯着我 而是看着我左右摇头
requirements.acceptance: Live: head yaw spread under 0.06 rad while the face is locked (brain log q[12]).
evidence: 18:53: +-0.35 rad swing, 2.2 s period; fix uses the measured head pose at frame time
requirements.gap: 19:21 run tracked a face but its swing was not measured.

requirements.title: Quacks once when it answers
shawn: 叫他的时候它可以转头并叫一下
开始还有转头 但是没有叫声 后面连转头也没有了
requirements.acceptance: Live: every answer plays a quack (unless the caller is really repeating).
requirements.gap: No live count of quacks per answer since the playback fix.

requirements.title: Stays balanced; never wanders off after finding the face
shawn: 第二，他摔了，你看看是什么问题导致的。
而且他都识别到我的脸了 结果开始乱走 自己把自己绊倒了
requirements.acceptance: Live: zero falls and zero walking commands other than the planned body turn during name-call tests.
requirements.gap: No fall in the 18:53 and 19:21 runs; not counted formally.
